member.name: OdooClient
member.summary:
Client for the Odoo external JSON-RPC API (/jsonrpc).
Instance methods log in automatically on first use. The user id is cached per server, database and user name, so creating many clients with the same logs in only once. When Odoo answers with AccessDenied (e.g. changed password), the client logs in again and retries the request once.
Server and transport errors (Odoo exceptions, HTTP errors, timeouts, invalid JSON) are not thrown - they are returned as with = false and details in . Invalid arguments (e.g. model without ) throw .
Static methods taking and userUid are low level variants: they use the shared built-in HttpClient, do not log in and do not retry. Use them when you manage the user id yourself (see ).

member.name: CallMethodAsync
member.summary:
Calls any public method of an Odoo model with positional and named arguments (Odoo execute_kw). Logs in when needed. Use it for methods with keyword arguments, e.g. posting a note on a record:
await client.CallMethodAsync("res.partner", "message_post", new object[] { new long[] { partnerId } }, new Dictionary<string, object> { ["body"] = "Note", ["message_type"] = "comment", ["subtype_xmlid"] = "mail.mt_note" });
member.param: Positional arguments; for methods on records the first one is the array of record ids. Null sends no positional arguments.
Named arguments, or null. Context is added from .
member.returns: Raw value returned by the method, or failed result.
